versions.changelog: Composio para buscar (Tavily y Apify) con comandos exactos en f100k-puente, actores con virgulilla y reglas de evidencia

Initial release: launches the investigacion-ads-formula100k skill for paid ad research with the FÓRMULA 100K and GOAT (Hormozi) frameworks.

- Enables systematic investigation of Meta Ads Library and TikTok Creative Center (public mode, agent browser first, Apify for large batches)
- Extracts and dissects 30–50+ winning ad references per request, breaking them down into Hook (80%), Meat (15%), and CTA (5%)
- Generates winning angles, hooks, and mass-ad variant ideas with the H × M × C modular system
- Clear guidance on differences between paid ad creatives and organic content, with doctrine and practical frameworks
- Organized outputs: References and scripts are saved into structured folders and provided as .md docs in Telegram
- Includes best-practice checklists for agent browsing and batching, and offers CTA formulas for highly actionable results
